title: Boston and New York in the early 1950s
summary: He led two bands in Boston with Rex Stewart in the first, then opened Wally's in New York.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Where did he work in Boston?
I worked in the Savoy and I worked in the High-Hat. I had Rex Stewart in my band out there.
Then you weren't working with Red between '45 and '50?
I had Rex Stewart in my first band. stop
When did you start that band?
That was after the 50's. That was about '53.
So in other words, you stayed with Red up until '50?
About 10 years you and Red - the whole 40's you stayed with Henry Red Allen? Is that correct?
I don't know. But I know how long I stayed in Boston. I went to New York from Boston.
That was about '50. That was about '52.
And opened in Wally's first, Wally's Paradise and then I went to the Savoy...
